caption:
ARN has locked in the Australian Open for five summers.

The partnership starts with AO27 and makes ARN the tournament's audio partner. Expect live shows from Melbourne Park, a dedicated AO DAB+ channel in Sydney and Melbourne, iHeart streaming, and an Are Media extension into ELLE and Gourmet Traveller. Neither side has put a number on it.

Also in the database: YoPRO x Australian Open, Hotels.com x Real Madrid, City of Parramatta x Western Sydney Wanderers, Bombay Sapphire x E1 Miami GP and Ant Group x UEFA Euro 2028.
